summary: A Codex seat whose turn fails on a 429 or a dropped connection stays up, idle and rate-limited or reconnecting, and st resumes the turn in the same session after a backoff; it faults only after the retries run out

replay.detail: No claim kind or field changes; harness.observed records idle with a reason word, and harness.diagnostic uses its existing fields.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or CLI change. The Codex driver keeps an incarnation idle, with reason rateLimited (httpStatusCode 429) or connection, when a turn fails on a typed connection-class cause even after Codex stopped retrying; before, the seat ended and failed. rateLimited is a new value of the free-text harness reason, beside the existing connection and providerCapacity; no client branches on these values. The daemon backs off from 30 s doubling to 10 min with jitter and raises the error diagnostic after 6 attempts, the same path providerCapacity takes today.

recovery.detail: Reverting makes a 429 past Codex's own retries end the seat again; no state migration is needed.
